City services

Parking permits

Residents can buy a yearly parking permit for their street online or at city hall during opening hours.

Park reservations

Picnic shelters and sports fields can be booked up to six months ahead, and a booking can be moved once at no charge.

Trash and recycling

Bins go out by seven in the morning on your collection day, with the lids closed and the handles facing the street.

Water service

Start, stop or move your water service with two business days of notice, and pay your bill online or by phone.

Street lighting

Report a broken street light with the pole number printed on it, and a crew will repair it within five working days.
